title: Predict before changing the supports
prompt: A horizontal beam rests on three vertical rollers. Is it stable in the plane?

choices.label: Yes, because there are three reaction components.
No, because horizontal translation is unrestrained.
No, because every roller permits the whole beam to rotate freely.

explanation: All three reactions are vertical. They cannot oppose horizontal translation. The reaction count alone therefore does not establish stability.

title: Predict before moving the load
prompt: For a pin at A and a vertical roller at B, move the downward force towards B without changing its magnitude. What happens to the upward reaction at A?

choices.label: It remains half of the applied force.

explanation: Taking moments about B gives A_y L = P(L − a). As a increases, the lever arm L − a decreases. The reaction A_y therefore decreases.

title: Check the diagram at the load
prompt: At the downward point force P, with no applied couple at that point, which statement is correct?

choices.label: Bending moment jumps, while shear force is continuous.
Both shear force and bending moment jump.
Shear force jumps by −P, while bending moment is continuous.

explanation: The point force changes V from A_y to A_y − P. There is no concentrated couple, and both expressions for M give A_y a at the load. The bending-moment diagram has a corner there.
